status.summary: Active but coming off a knockout loss, and he says he will not fight again in 2026. Arman Tsarukyan knocked him out with an elbow in the clinch at 4:56 of round 1 in the five-round UFC 331 co-main event in Los Angeles (Sep 19, 2026). That ended a two-fight win streak: TKO wins over Rafael Fiziev (UFC 325, Sydney, Jan 31, 2026 US time / Feb 1 local) and Michael Chandler (UFC Freedom 250, White House South Lawn, Jun 14, 2026). Pro record 14-3-0 with 13 KO/TKO wins (ESPN, UFCalendar, ufcrankings.org); UFC 5-2. On Oct 15, 2026 he denied reports of a December fight with Salahdine Parnasse: 'I'm not going to fight now', and the news he had teased was about his own training space, where he said Alexander Volkanovski and Israel Adesanya are coming to train. ESPN and UFCalendar list no booking on Nov 6. Camp: he trained for UFC 325 at Volkanovski's Freestyle MMA in Sydney, and Bloody Elbow (May 8, 2026, search snippet only; the page returned 403) reported that he had officially left the Fighting Nerds. ESPN still lists Fighting Nerds as his team.
status.ranking: #8 lightweight in the UFC media-panel rankings (Nov 3, 2026, per ufcalendar.com; ufcrankings.org, updated Nov 5, agrees) and #10 in the UFC/Meta algorithmic rankings (Oct 31, 2026 board, published Nov 3; ufcalendar.com and MMA Mania). ufc.com/rankings returned 403 to scripts. The earlier note that he was No. 10 on the media panel mixed up the two boards: No. 10 is his Meta position.

injuries.what: cut near the right eye from the Tsarukyan knockout. The California commission suspended him 45 days (30 with no contact), plus 60 days unless a physician clears the cut. That runs to about Nov 18, 2026. No later medical news was found

style.summary: A rangy orthodox striker with big, accurate power. He has six knockdowns in under 49 UFC minutes and finishes hurt opponents on the ground, plus a spinning-wheel-kick KO. On the feet he mostly targets the head and is rarely hit there. His two losses came when grapplers (Saint Denis, Tsarukyan) dragged him into the clinch and onto the mat.

moves.notes: Group weights (head, body, leg) each sum to 1. The engine's target split should come from fighters.json: recency-weighted landed shares are head 0.82 / body 0.08 / leg 0.11 and attempt shares are head 0.86 / body 0.07 / leg 0.07 (lightweight median landed about 0.62 / 0.22 / 0.15). So he is far more head-focused than the division and body work is rare. The head group favours the rear straight and hooks behind a jab, because his finishes are punches at distance or knockdowns into ground strikes (Mullarkey, Fiziev, Chandler). Head kicks get a little weight for the wheel-kick KO. Spinning is 0.15, well above most lightweights, for the same KO (UFC Stats: 'Kick to Head At Distance, Wheel kick', UFC 313). Body and leg groups are generic splits because UFC Stats does not separate kicks from punches there. Knee and elbow are low: only 4% of his landed strikes come in the clinch. These weights are analyst judgment on a 7-fight sample; no published technique breakdown could be fetched in this pass.

appearance.hair: dark brown, short tapered sides with a longer top swept up and back (ESPN studio photos, Jun and Sep 2026; White House press photo, Jun 12, 2026)
appearance.facial_hair: full dark-brown beard, about 2-3 cm, with a joined moustache and neat cheek lines (same photos)
appearance.tattoos: heavily tattooed on the chest and left arm. A large black-and-grey chest piece covers both pecs, with 'Ruffy' in gothic script in the centre and a grinning cartoon-style character over the left pec. That fits the One Piece origin of his nickname, but the theme is not confirmed. A full black-and-grey left sleeve: a woman's portrait under an owl on the shoulder, an elephant above the elbow, and a crowned skull and a clock on the forearm. No large tattoo shows on the right arm in the studio photos

engine_notes.note: Knockdown power: 6 knockdowns in 48.7 UFC minutes (1.85 per 15 min; lightweight median about 0.31), at least one in 5 of his 7 fights.
Accuracy and defence at range: 56.5% significant accuracy (median about 47%) and 59% defence (median about 54%), absorbing 3.5 per minute career.

Takedown defence is good on first contact (26 of 30 stopped, 87%) but grapplers keep shooting: 9.2 attempts against him per 15 min, and 166-187 seconds of opponent control per 15. Both losses followed sustained clinch or wrestling pressure.
No offensive grappling recorded: 0 of 1 on takedowns and 0 submission attempts in the UFC.

Almost no late-round data: his only five-round booking (Tsarukyan, UFC 331) ended in round 1, and only the Llontop decision went 15 minutes. Cardio and late-round output are unknown and should carry wide uncertainty.
